open_questions: First deep dive post batch onboard 2026-06-11; synthesis weights pending human approval.
Entry band **€105–115** for ~15% base is **[Assumption]**; confirm with refreshed price and FY2026 interim FCF.
Reference-shareholder governance (23.6% block) may affect M&A optionality; not in base IRR.
thesis: Euronext N.V. is the leading pan-European market infrastructure group: regulated equity, fixed-income, and derivatives venues, central counterparty clearing, securities services, market data, and primary listings across Amsterdam, Paris, Brussels, Lisbon, Milan, Oslo, Dublin, and Athens. **[Fact]** FY2025 underlying revenue and income was **€1,823.2 million** (+12.1% versus 2024), adjusted EBITDA reached about **€1.1 billion**, and free cash flow was **€682.3 million** (`investor-documents/ir-euronext/urd_2025.pdf`, §5.2.4). **[Fact]** Q1 2026 underlying revenue and income was **€528.5 million** (+15.3% versus Q1 2025), with adjusted EBITDA **€343.2 million** and margin **64.9%** (`investor-documents/ir-euronext/q1_2026_press_release.pdf`). The company earns toll-like fees on trading, clearing, listing, custody, and data subscriptions with minimal principal risk on core operations (Stahl croupier).
why_market_wrong: There is no dated structural discount or yield-curve payoff. **[Inference]** Q1 2026 is the eighth consecutive quarter of double-digit revenue growth on elevated market volatility; the market may treat that run rate as durable. **[Inference]** Our base case uses FY2025 free cash flow per share (**€6.73**), not Q1 2026 peak volumes or the **€2.13** adjusted earnings per share quarter. Return is franchise quality at price, not a mispricing with a known catalyst date. **Predictive attribute:** none.
